rules: Repair history is append-only. New events are added; earlier events are not rewritten to make current state cleaner.
One transaction_id represents one failed-receipt lineage. A changed repaired subject remains in the same transaction lineage but always has a new exact SHA.
TRANSACTION_OPENED is idempotent by transaction_id plus receipt_id; conflicting duplicate lineage fails closed.
Only REPAIRABLE_SUBJECT transactions may emit changed-SHA replacement tickets.
A replacement ticket requires deterministic prequalification PASS on the exact replacement SHA and preserves qualification_id, workstream_id and parent receipt lineage.
Repair events and owner inbox state are routing/control evidence only; they never create A-01 PASS, promotion, author, publication or production authority.
Human, author, private-data, native-platform and external-authority routes do not emit automated product replacement tickets.
The System State Reconciler may derive current repair standing from event history and owner inbox projections.
